cohort: Medicaid beneficiaries and commercially insured pregnant women in Florida
finding: The implementation of the Statewide Medicaid Managed Care (SMMC) program in Florida was associated with a significant reduction in primary cesarean rates, preterm births, preventable postpartum ED visits, and readmissions among Medicaid beneficiaries compared to commercially insured women.
mod_finding: This study found that the Statewide Medicaid Managed Care program in Florida was associated with a reduction in primary cesarean rates among Medicaid beneficiaries compared to commercially insured counterparts.
